question: Which divine epithets are saluted in this hymn?
premises: dharmasādhāraṇavarāya means to bestower of common dharma
carācarātmane means to soul of moving and unmoving
inference: The deity is praised as dharma-bestower and soul of all beings.
plain_english: Obeisance to the bestower of common dharma and the soul of moving and unmoving things.
